duas.arabic: أعيذكما بكلمات الله التامة ، من كل شيطان وهامة ، ومن كل عينِ لامة
duas.transliteration: U'īthukumā bikalimāti 'llāhit-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmah, wa min kulli 'aynin lāmmah
duas.translation: I seek protection for you in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every beast, and from every envious blameworthy eye.
duas.context: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to seek Allah's protection for Al-Hasan and Al-Husain by saying:
